notes: Three isnads (ح, ح, ح) meet at Waki' and then share the tail: «الأعمش، عن أبي وائل، عن عبد الله» is written once, after the last isnad's names
«- واللفظ له -» is a transmission gloss: left out
«قال فدخل الأشعث بن قيس» is an appended anecdote in which Ash'ath speaks: not a route (the chain ends at Ibn Mas'ud)
